column1: # Cloud images for full-distro mode. URL may contain one * in the file name,
# resolved against the directory listing (newest match). The optional prep
# column is a shell command cloud-init runs before the payload (needs the
# guest's network), e.g. to install the package that carries ublk_drv.

column5: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq linux-modules-extra-$(uname -r) xfsprogs
